evolutions.name: Intro to Evolutions
evolutions.description: Welcome to Evolutions in FC 27! Upgrade a player of your choice and unlock their first attribute boost.

evolutions.name: Intro to Training Camp EVOs
evolutions.description: Send your players to training camp! Collect their attribute upgrades when the training session concludes.

evolutions.name: Intro to Repeatable Evolutions
evolutions.description: Discover Repeatable Evolutions, allowing you to run multiple players through the same upgrade path!

evolutions.name: Intro to Pathway Evolutions
evolutions.description: Explore Pathway Evolutions, a new type of Evolution that allows you to choose how your player develops and upgrades!
